### State Street Recognized By Euromoney Awards


10/01/2026


Download this Press Release (opens in new window)


**BOSTON, MA, October 1, 2026 –** State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced that it has been recognized with five industry awards from Euromoney’s prestigious 2026 FX awards


For more than 45 years, Euromoney's FX Awards have recognized leading providers of foreign exchange services worldwide and are widely regarded as one of the industry's most respected benchmarks for excellence in the wholesale FX market.


State Street Markets was named the winner in the following categories:


- World’s Best FX Bank for Real Money Clients


- World's Best Bank for FX Research


- World's Best FX Venue for Real Money (FX Connect®)


- World's Best Provider of TCA Solutions (BestX®)


- World's Best FX Solution for Real Money Clients (LINK)


"We are honored to be recognized across five categories in this year's Euromoney FX Awards. These awards reflect the strength of our platform, the dedication of our teams and the trust our clients place in us every day,” said Tony Bisegna, executive vice president and head of State Street Markets. “We are particularly proud to be named World's Best Bank for FX Research for the fifth consecutive year, a distinction that highlights the quality of our research and insights and our commitment to helping clients navigate evolving market conditions and make informed investment decisions."


Learn more about State Street Market’s[Foreign Exchange](https://www.statestreet.com/lu/en/solutions/foreign-exchange) **** offerings, ****[Insights](https://globalmarkets.statestreet.com/research/portal/insights/?target=https:%2F%2Fglobalmarkets.statestreet.com%2Fresearch%2Fmyportal%2Finsights) **** and[Electronic Trading platforms](https://www.statestreet.com/us/en/asset-manager/solutions/liquidity/electronic-trading-platforms-globallink) **.**


**About State Street Corporation**


State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $57.9 trillion in assets under custody and/or administration and $6.3 trillion* in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, State Street operates globally in more than 100 geographic markets and employs approximately 51,000 worldwide. For more information, visit State Street's website at[www.statestreet.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.statestreet.com&esheet=54578208&newsitemid=20260728894679&lan=en-US&anchor=www.statestreet.com&index=1&md5=636f0962e2bd767cc8b2b612e87fce4c) .


**Assets under management as of June 30, 2026 includes approximately $157 billion of assets with respect to SPDR® products for which State Street Global Advisors Funds Distributors, LLC (SSGA FD) acts solely as the marketing agent. SSGA FD and State Street Investment Management are affiliated.*
